title: Exotic isotopes
summary: Isotopes (◇) come from violet seams, mined by a Deep-Core Mine. Advanced buildings need them.
text:
**Exotic isotopes** (◇ in the top bar) are a second resource for advanced work: Fusion Cells burn them, and Shield Projectors, Matter Printers, the Launch Gantry and some research cost them.

Research **Deep Survey** at a Tech Lab, then build a **Deep-Core Mine** on one of the glowing violet isotope seams. Seams are often out past your build area, so a Relay Tower helps.

- The drill is loud: predator packs go for a Deep-Core Mine first, so guard it well
- Deep mines draw a lot of power
- Isotope mining scars the land more than alloys do
- Relic caches can hold isotopes too
